role: Federal agency commenter on draft EIS
stance_basis: paraphrased comments noting total energy systems are not unique and raising design problems, while also suggesting potential use of fuel cells
summary: The Federal Power Commission submitted comments on the draft EIS noting that total energy systems are not unique and flagging some design problems with the Jersey City total energy installation. The Commission also raised the potential use of fuel cells as an alternative energy technology. HUD responded by pointing to the final statement's discussion of the total energy system and explaining that fuel cell development had not yet reached a stage warranting a BREAKTHROUGH demonstration.
complaint_summary: The Federal Power Commission commented that total energy systems are not unique and identified some design problems with the proposed total energy system.
summary_quote: Comment: Total energy systems are not unique; some design problems.
